messages.subject: [Rsiena-help] Discrimination of Incoming Ties
messages.body_plain:
Hi Group.

What is the recommended way (if any) to differentiate between 'activity' due
to in an in-tie from an actor with covariate X=0 and an actor with covariate
X=1? For example, being nominated by an alter with trait 1 causes ego to
nominate more alters than if ego were nominated by an alter with trait 0.

-- 
Nathan Doogan
Doctoral Student
The Ohio State University
